title: Regulation of Nrf2 signaling and longevity in naturally long-lived rodents
abstract:
18. Lewis KN, Mele J, Hayes JD, Buffenstein R (2010) Nrf2, a guardian of health span and · gatekeeper of species longevity.
Keap1 and βTrCP Regulate Nrf2-Signaling Activity in Long-Lived · Species.
Nrf2 Regulation in Species with Divergent Longevity.
Nrf2 activity is an essential modulator of species longevity.

The · mechanisms behind the universal resilience of longer-lived organ- isms to stress, however, remain elusive. We hypothesize that this · resilience is linked to the activity of a highly conserved transcrip- tion factor, nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor (Nrf2).
